desc.english: Match the historical decision at 90%+ of comparable points.
Outperform the historical choice at 60%+ of comparable points.
Keep organized resistance running to October 1945 or beyond.
Finish a war with Manpower at +4 or better.
Preside over a front collapse: some lessons only teach themselves this way.

name.english: The War That Never Went East

desc.english: Find the war in which Barbarossa was never launched.
End the war holding Festung Norwegen, intact and unbeaten.
Complete a war whose exact dice path had under 5% compound likelihood.
Complete a German war in Führer Mode.
In Führer Mode, spend every point of political capital defying the command structure.
Complete a Soviet war under NKVD Mode without being recalled.
Find out what NKVD Mode was watching for.
Finish a war under Yalta Mode with Coalition Cohesion strongly positive.
Finish a war under Yalta Mode with Coalition Cohesion critically frayed, and hold the alliance together anyway.
Complete an Italian war under Axis Mode without being superseded.
Find out what Axis Mode was watching for.
Complete a German war matching the historical record at nearly every comparable decision.
Complete a Soviet war matching the historical record at nearly every comparable decision.
Complete an Allied war matching the historical record at nearly every comparable decision.
Capture Moscow, and learn what it does and doesn't decide.
Reach one of the campaign's rarest speculative endings: the two armistices, or the earliest end this war ever reaches.
Finish a war meaningfully earlier than it actually ended, from either side that wanted it over.
Reach one of the surplus-only decisions and take it: a choice available solely to a command that arrived with something left.
Refuse separate terms with the war visibly ending and the offer on the table.
Complete a war from every high command: OKW, STAVKA, Comando Supremo, IGHQ, the War Cabinet and the Joint Chiefs.
Complete an Italian war matching the historical record at nearly every comparable decision.
